mapper.sql: id, menu_id, name, code, path, method, sort, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM t_sys_user_role ur JOIN t_sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN t_sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN t_sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND p.status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM t_sys_user_role ur JOIN t_sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
SELECT code, path, method FROM t_sys_permission WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
